coach.welcomeBody: In a couple of minutes I'll show you how everything works. I'll open the right screens myself and point with an arrow where to tap. All you do is press «Next». First, pick your language:
coach.todayBody: Open it in the morning: everything waiting for you today is here — events, to-dos and shopping.
coach.statusBody: Tap here and pick what you're doing right now: «at work», «driving», «sleeping». Your partner sees it straight away.
coach.actionsBody: One tap and you're in the section you need. You can choose which buttons sit here in Settings.
coach.ritualBody: Every day you do something together, the flame keeps burning and the mascot grows. No pressure: missed days are forgiven.
coach.tabsBody: Tap the icons to move between sections. You can change which sections sit here too.
coach.tabsWideBody: Tap a section in the list on the left to open it. You can change the order: Settings → Sections.
coach.moreBody: All the other sections live here: budget, recipes, trips, wishlist, photos and more.
coach.addBody: Tap this field and type what to buy. Several at once with commas works too: «milk, bread, cheese». Then tap «+» — everything sorts itself into aisles.
coach.swipeBody: Slide a row to the right — it's marked as bought. To the left — it's deleted. Deleted by mistake? «Undo» shows up at the bottom for a few seconds.
coach.taskBody: Tap «+» and write in plain words: «call mum tomorrow at 6 pm». The date and time fill in by themselves.
coach.privacyBody: Any entry can be «Only me» — then nobody but you sees it. Or a «Surprise» — your partner only sees it on the day you choose.
coach.calendarBody: Shared events and birthdays. Tap a day to see what's on. Google Calendar is connected in Settings.
coach.usBody: Your mascot lives here. Tap it — it'll be happy. Below are your moods and small quests for the day.
coach.settingsBody: Tap here to change the language, theme, notifications and look. You can take this tour again there too.
coach.installIos: Put the app on your Home Screen
coach.installIosBody: Then it opens like a normal app and can send notifications. At the bottom of Safari tap «Share» (the square with an arrow) → «Add to Home Screen».
coach.installAndroidBody: Then it opens like a normal app and can send notifications. In Chrome tap ⋮ at the top right → «Install app».
coach.doneBody: That's the essentials. The rest you'll find along the way — and if you forget something, the tour is always in Settings.
